description: This source file defines the CacheConfig class which configures and manages cache settings for the OpenMRS project using Infinispan. It includes setup for clustering, cache templates, loading configurations from YAML files, and creating cache managers for dependency injection.

classes.name: CacheConfig
classes.description: Configures and manages cache settings for OpenMRS, supporting clustered and local caches with Infinispan.

methods.name: apiCacheManager
methods.description: Creates and configures an instance of SpringEmbeddedCacheManager based on XML and YAML configs, supporting clustering with JGroups.

methods.name: getCacheConfigurations
methods.description: Loads cache configuration files from the classpath that match pattern 'classpath*:cache-api.yaml'.

methods.name: getJChannelConfig
methods.description: Returns default JChannel configuration file path based on specified cache stack.
